info.title: CareerPilot API
info.description: All endpoints are served by the API gateway under `/api`. Authentication uses httpOnly cookies (`access_token`, 15 min; `refresh_token`, rotating). API clients may instead send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Errors always look like `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`. Validation errors return 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with per-field details.

bearerAuth.description: Same access token as the cookie, for API clients like Postman.
